profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Boston Scientific
profile.summary: With over 25 years of software engineering experience, I have a broad array of skills. For many years, I have been in lead and senior software engineering positions. I am now fully focused on DevOps work, and I am loving the challenge.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer (DevOps)
positions.locationName: St Paul, Minnesota, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: RTC · Gitlab · Bash · Maven · Kubernetes · Git

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I used ASP.NET and Ruby to build RESTful web services and web applications. These applications used Braintree to offer PCI-compliant processing of credit card payments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead developer for Tennant’s website, which is built on AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) and SAP Hybris. In addition to working on the website’s core Java, my skillset includes Apache Solr and Apache HTTP Server, as well as frontend technologies like HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript.

I was also responsible for Jenkins, Docker, and Atlassian Stash (for source code management with Git). Our team worked in an agile environment using Jira and Confluence. 

I previously served as a project manager for some critical projects. Additionally, I supported Tennant’s field service system, which is built on Microsoft technologies (like VB.NET and SQL Server), and is integrated with SAP.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Lead developer of a collections and customer service application. Extensive involvement in design, development, testing, and deployment. Implemented with VB.NET and DB2 stored procedures. Improved the user experience by enhancing the look and feel of critical applications.

positions.title: Database Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed complex processes to load book and music-related data to SQL Server, serving the company's e-commerce needs. Used VB, DTS, and stored procedures. Extensive tuning of stored procedures to improve performance on the web.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description: Acting as a technical lead, provided consulting services for clients. Provided them solutions using Microsoft products like ASP, SQL Server, and VB. Also managed projects and provided training.

company.name: RBC Global Asset Management / Dain Rauscher
